description:
[Admin]

Everything needed to design a style for one kind of page block (hero, cards, faq, ...): the selectors each block renders, its layout variants, the CSS variables of the brand, and the styles the editor already offers per block type. Read it before save_component_style. Style settings are switched on per company by JobMojito; while they are off this endpoint answers 403.

brand_id.description: A sub-brand, from the brands document of get_portal_configuration. Leave it out for the main brand, the company's own, whose styles every sub-brand page also offers.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

portal.description: `interview` (career and interview portal) or `consumer` (coaching portal). Only the interview portal has brands.

name: Get_the_component_style_guide

written_by.description: `agent`: in components/, which save_component_style may change. `company`: in the company's own files, never changed by it.

how_to.description: The steps from a design to a live style.

what.description: What it is on the page.
